subject: Shiny Error: the application unexpectedly exited shiny

messages.author: c944e424fd78eae4
messages.subject: Shiny Error: the application unexpectedly exited shiny
parts:
I have a shiny server and am trying to deploy a new app. I have a number of apps that work great and have no problems at all.

I recently built an app that utilizes ggvis. It works locally and also works from my rstudio server locally. But when I deploy it to the shiny server and try and utilize the ggvis plot it gives me an error. 

"the application unexpectedly exited shiny"

I have looked this up and tried a number of different things and nothing worked. 

Any ideas?

I have attached my shiny-server.conf file and a screen shot.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Error: the application unexpectedly exited shiny
parts:
Did you check the browser console for error? 

It is possible that one or more of R packages you are referencing in your code is not installed on the server where Shiny Server is running. Or it might be installed for just certain users, not globally.

Fereshteh
